description: This file defines the LogLevel enumeration used for specifying log levels in connection logs, including SUCCESS and FAILURE levels with associated string labels and utility methods.

classes.name: LogLevel
classes.description: An enum representing different levels of connection logging, specifically SUCCESS and FAILURE with their string labels and utility methods.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the string label associated with the log level.

methods.name: forLevel
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the LogLevel that matches the given string level, performing a null check beforehand.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string label of the LogLevel instance.
